The '''Ruins of Zul'Kunda'''  are very large [[jungle troll]] ruins in [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. This is the territory of the [[Bloodscalp tribe]], and their leaders, [[Nezzliok the Dire]] and [[Gan'zulah]], are stationed here. It is accessed via a path heading east from [[Zuuldaia Ruins]].
